verdict.rationale: Tavily has a dedicated rate-limits page listing requests per minute by environment (Development 100, Production 1,000) and documenting 429 responses with a retry-after header. The pricing page shows a free tier of 1,000 credits/month with no credit card and a 'Pay only for what you use' model, which implies a self-serve paid path but does not describe how to upgrade. A usage endpoint lets developers check their consumption. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrency caps, a clearly described self-serve upgrade flow with tier-specific limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
